state.exact_retry: An existing owner already recorded operation A, seed v1, matching 64-hex digest, edition-request event R, note N and actor P. Caller repeats precisely A/v1/digest/R/N/P.
state.changed_intent: The owner already recorded A/v1/digest/R/N/P. Caller repeats A with note changed to M.
state.unverified: A caller supplies a nonempty UUID R that is not a real committed edition request; all other fields are structurally valid. No external source verification happens before Record.
state.different_edition: One owner is opened under edition E1 and another owner under different edition E2 with identical category and code. AggregateIdentity.Create derives the owner from all supplied typed parts.
state.invalid_replay: A disclosure owner for edition E1 is replayed with one disclosure event whose EditionId is E2; all other fields match.
state.competing: Two fresh instances target the same disclosure stream. Both call Record successfully in memory. The event store atomically appends one batch at expected position zero; the second tries expected zero after the first commit.
state.fingerprint: The owner receives any syntactically valid 64-character lowercase hexadecimal string; the owner does not calculate the fingerprint from the seed content.

exact_noop.instructions: In exact_retry, does the second call raise another disclosure event?

changed_conflict.instructions: In changed_intent, does the second call reject the changed note?

spoof_accept.instructions: In unverified, can the aggregate accept the fake source event ID?

source_verifies.instructions: Does Record itself load and verify the referenced edition event from durable source?

isolation.instructions: In different_edition, do the two owners have distinct stream identities?

foreign_replay.instructions: In invalid_replay, does the owner reject replay?

both_commit.instructions: In competing, can both appends at expected zero commit to the same stream?

hash_proof.instructions: In fingerprint, does the accepted string by itself prove the actual seed content matches?

parent_roster.instructions: Does this owner retain a collection of other disclosures?
